public/data/dem.i16.credit: NASA/JPL/MSSS/USGS (MRO CTX via JPL Mars Trek)
processing: Read Float32 GeoTIFF with geotiff.js; origin/pixel scale give outer edges (PixelIsArea).
Converted projected X,Y to lon/lat edges: lon = X/R, lat = Y/R (equirectangular, lat_ts 0, lon0 0).
Encoded Int16 LE: v = round((h - -2113) / 0.05); nodata -32768; max quantisation error 0.0250 m.
hRef = median of 2413152 valid cells.

public/data/geology.json.productLabel: USGS SIM 3464 Jezero_FeatureServiceFromPro (layer 8 Geologic Units, layer 2 LandingEllipse)

public/data/geology.json.projection: Source MTM (central meridian 77.5E, Mars 2000 sphere) reprojected server-side to Mars 2000 geographic (outSR)
processing: Paged layer 8 with resultOffset (maxRecordCount 2000), outSR Mars 2000 geographic, geometryPrecision 6.
Split Esri multipart polygons into outer ring (clockwise) + holes; kept polygons whose outer-ring bbox overlaps the DEM bbox (not clipped).
Vertices rounded to 5 decimals (~0.6 m) with consecutive duplicates removed; Douglas-Peucker simplification at 1e-5 deg (~0.6 m).
Units keyed by symbol; "Crater riim unit" typo variant merged into "cr" ("Crater rim unit").
Colours assigned by this project (not USGS). Added fields: unitOrder, colorNote.
Landing ellipse (layer 2) outer rings stored in `ellipse`.

processing: Parsed zipped shapefile (332 LineString segments) with shapefile + JSZip.
Sorted segments by SCLK_START, concatenated, dropped repeated vertices, kept vertices inside DEM bounds; [lon,lat][] with 6 decimals.
Segments are joined end-to-start; gaps between drives (if any) appear as straight connectors.

processing: Mars Trek search (rows=2100, q=*) holds 1783 nomenclature items, only 1 near the DEM, so the USGS Gazetteer centre-point shapefile was used as the main source.
Kept features with centre inside DEM bbox ±0.2°; type reduced to the singular head word; diameter in km as published; Trek-only names added if missing.

public/data/context_dem.i16.datum: Mars 2000 sphere R=3396190 m; MOLA topography above the areoid (GMM-3), same reference as the CTX DEM
public/data/context_dem.i16.credit: NASA/GSFC/MGS MOLA (PDS Geosciences Node); NASA/JPL/MSSS/The Caltech Murray Lab/Esri (MRO CTX global mosaic via JPL Mars Trek)
processing: Range request for rows 3090..3450 of megt44n000hb.img (16-bit MSB, metres above the areoid).
Bilinear resample to 384x346 so the outer edges equal lon 75.9..78.9, lat 17.1..19.8.
Encoded Int16 LE with scale 0.25 m, offset 0. hRef (median) -2060 m.
Datum check vs the CTX DEM (4352 footprints): mean -3.02 m, median 1.86 m, sd 25.78 m; flat footprints (1399): median 6.16 m.
The PDS server sends an incomplete TLS chain, so the download used curl --insecure; integrity is covered by the datum check.

processing: Parsed Trek's WMTSCapabilities.xml; its ResourceURL points at astro.arcgis.com (the trek.nasa.gov tile path returns 404). Fetched 90 level 9 tiles.

Greyscale JPEG quality 80 (mozjpeg), 1.03 MB.
Registration vs the controlled 6 m mosaic: best integer shift 0,2 px (0,87 m); NCC 0.566 at zero shift.
imageGainToPatch 1.4793: linear-light brightness gain matching the 6 m mosaic over the overlap (applied in the shader).
